newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Irish Progressive Life says business up in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Irish Progressive Life says business up in 1996.

text.p: Irish Permanent Plc said on Friday that its life assurance arm, Irish Progressive Life, reported a 32 percent rise in new annual premium income in 1996 to 11.4 million punts.
New single premium income was up 120 percent at 20.6 million Irish pounds, Irish Permanent said in a statement.
"New single premium income, on the back of good investment results, was very buoyant in both the pensions and investments sectors," the company said.
Following the launch of a new range of products in 1996, all product areas showed substantial growth, Irish Permanent said.

The individual pensions sector was some 27 percent ahead of 1995 in terms of new annual premiums, the protection market posted new annual premium growth of 14 percent and the saving market showed growth of 250 percent.

"We are particularly pleased to see growth in all product lines -- protection, pensions, savings and investment. New products introduced during the year have proved very successful in the highly competitive independent broker market where we expect to have increased our overall market share," Frank McHugh, managing director of Irish Progressive Life, said in the statement.
